Specification: TLAPS proof library for well-founded induction. Defines IsTransitivelyClosedOn, IsWellFoundedOn, SetLessThan, WFDefOn, OpDefinesFcn, WFInductiveDefines, WFInductiveUnique, TransitiveClosureOn, OpToRel, PreImage, LexPairOrdering, LexProductOrdering and proves theorems WFMin/MinWF, WFInduction, WFDefOnUnique, WFInductiveDef, WFInductiveDefType, TransitiveClosureWF/Thm/Minimal/ChopLast, NatLessThanWellFounded, PreImageWellFounded, WFLexPairOrdering, WFLexProductOrdering, plus several lemmas.
SetEnumeration: { ss \in S \X S : \A U \in SUBSET (S \X S) : /\ R \cap S \X S \subseteq U /\ IsTransitivelyClosedOn(U, S) => ss \in U }
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE g : g = [x \in S |-> Def(g, x)]
AssumeProveBlocks: ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW T \in SUBSET S, IsWellFoundedOn(R,S) PROVE IsWellFoundedOn(R,T)
ASSUME NEW S, NEW R, NEW RR, RR \cap (S \X S) \subseteq R, IsWellFoundedOn(R,S) PROVE IsWellFoundedOn(RR,S)
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, IsWellFoundedOn(R, S), NEW T, T \subseteq S, T # {} PROVE \E x \in T : \A y \in T : ~ (<<y, x>> \in R)
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, \A T \in SUBSET S : T # {} => \E x \in T : \A y \in T : ~ (<<y, x>> \in R) PROVE IsWellFoundedOn(R,S)
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW x \in S, IsWellFoundedOn(R, S) PROVE <<x, x>> \notin R
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW x \in S, NEW y \in S, IsWellFoundedOn(R,S), <<x,y>> \in R, <<y,x>> \in R PROVE FALSE
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW x \in S, IsWellFoundedOn(R,S) PROVE x \notin SetLessThan(x,R,S)
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW x \in S, NEW y \in SetLessThan(x,R,S), IsTransitivelyClosedOn(R, S) PROVE SetLessThan(y, R, S) \subseteq SetLessThan(x, R, S)
ASSUME NEW P(_), NEW R, NEW S, IsWellFoundedOn(R, S), \A x \in S : (\A y \in SetLessThan(x, R, S) : P(y)) => P(x) PROVE \A x \in S : P(x)
ASSUME NEW Def(_,_), NEW R, NEW S, IsWellFoundedOn(R, S), WFDefOn(R, S, Def) PROVE WFInductiveUnique(S, Def)
ASSUME NEW Def(_,_), NEW R, NEW S, NEW f, IsWellFoundedOn(R, S), IsTransitivelyClosedOn(R, S), WFDefOn(R, S, Def), OpDefinesFcn(f, S, Def) PROVE WFInductiveDefines(f, S, Def)
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW U \in SUBSET (S \X S), R \cap S \X S \subseteq U, IsTransitivelyClosedOn(U,S) PROVE TransitiveClosureOn(R,S) \subseteq U
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW i \in S, NEW j \in S, NEW k \in S, <<i,j>> \in TransitiveClosureOn(R,S), <<j,k>> \in TransitiveClosureOn(R,S) PROVE <<i,k>> \in TransitiveClosureOn(R,S)
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW i \in S, NEW j \in S, NEW k \in S, <<i,j>> \in TransitiveClosureOn(R,S), <<j,k>> \in R PROVE <<i,k>> \in TransitiveClosureOn(R,S)
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW i \in S, NEW j \in S, NEW k \in S, <<i,j>> \in R, <<j,k>> \in TransitiveClosureOn(R,S) PROVE <<i,k>> \in TransitiveClosureOn(R,S)
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW i \in S, NEW k \in S, <<i,k>> \in TransitiveClosureOn(R,S) PROVE \E j \in S : /\ <<j,k>> \in R /\ i = j \/ <<i,j>> \in TransitiveClosureOn(R,S)
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, IsWellFoundedOn(R,S) PROVE IsWellFoundedOn(TransitiveClosureOn(R, S), S)
ASSUME NEW Def(_,_), NEW R, NEW S, NEW f, IsWellFoundedOn(R, S), WFDefOn(R, S, Def), OpDefinesFcn(f, S, Def) PROVE WFInductiveDefines(f, S, Def)
ASSUME NEW Def(_,_), NEW f, NEW R, NEW S, NEW T, T # {}, IsWellFoundedOn(R, S), WFDefOn(R, S, Def), WFInductiveDefines(f, S, Def), \A g \in [S -> T], s \in S : Def(g, s) \in T PROVE f \in [S -> T]
ASSUME NEW S, NEW T, NEW R, NEW f(_), \A s \in S : f(s) \in T, IsWellFoundedOn(R, T) PROVE IsWellFoundedOn(PreImage(f, S, R), S)
ASSUME NEW R1, NEW R2, NEW S1, NEW S2, IsWellFoundedOn(R1, S1), IsWellFoundedOn(R2, S2) PROVE IsWellFoundedOn(LexPairOrdering(R1, R2, S1, S2), S1 \X S2)
ASSUME NEW R, NEW S, NEW n \in Nat, IsWellFoundedOn(R, S) PROVE IsWellFoundedOn(LexProductOrdering(R, S, n), [1..n -> S])
DivisionNotes: Predicate-shaped operators (IsTransitivelyClosedOn, IsWellFoundedOn, WFDefOn, OpDefinesFcn, WFInductiveDefines, WFInductiveUnique) are classified as StatePredicate (boolean predicates parameterised by relation/set arguments).
Set-builder/relation-construction operators (SetLessThan, TransitiveClosureOn, OpToRel, PreImage, LexPairOrdering, LexProductOrdering) are classified as ValueDef.
Module is a pure proof library: no Init/Spec/Next, no temporal operators -> TemporalNesting=false, OperatorDefNames_Init=[], TemporalProperty=[].
FunctionConstructor entries split: [x \in S |-> ...] forms in ByDomain; [S -> T] / [Nat -> S] / [1..n -> S] forms in SetType.
VerificationTools=TLAPS: all theorems and lemmas are TLAPS-proved (proofs in WellFoundedInduction_proofs).
